what_happened: Research confirmed all three dispatch-named edit sites for ITEM 1 (full-build phase-commit gate) and ITEM 2 (plan-section anchor-forward-from-heading rule) in the lean source store at current line numbers close to the dispatch's estimates. Also confirmed ITEM 2's failure mode has no existing generic home anywhere in the core extension (no section-splice/anchor pattern file exists), so the planner must choose between adding it narrowly to the 3 lean files (recommended: lowest friction, no scope widening needed) or creating a new core pattern file and widening file_scope.
